findings.title: Prodisee Pantry cancels Saturday food distribution due to weather concerns
findings.exact_supporting_passage: This Saturday's food distribution in Stockton has been cancelled out of an abundance of caution.
findings.summary: Prodisee Pantry canceled its Saturday food distribution in Stockton, Alabama because of developing tropical-weather risk. The report directs Baldwin County families needing food assistance to Tuesday morning distributions in Spanish Fort.
affected_groups: Baldwin County families needing food assistance
people relying on the Stockton food distribution
